name: great_river_mouth
description: 100 x 100 km game region at the mouth of the planet's largest temperate river (world candidate 3), split into 4 x 4 plots of 25 x 25 km.
centre_note: Chosen so the river mouth (57.875 N, 41.125 E) lies near the middle of plot tile_x2_y1, not on a plot border; the lower river, the coast and the near-shore sea are all inside the square.
projection: local tangent plane (azimuthal equidistant) centred on centre_lat/lon; x = east, y = north, in metres

tiles.naming: tile_x{col}_y{row}; col 0 = west, row 0 = north (Unreal tiled import order)
tiles.shared_edges: neighbouring tiles share their edge vertices exactly

unreal.landscape_size: 8129 x 8129 (1024 components of 254 x 254, 4 sections of 127 quads)
unreal.heightmap_format: 16-bit grayscale PNG, 32768 = 0 m, 128 units per metre
